message.subject: Completing Canon's outdoor durability story
message.body:
Hi [Name],

I've been following Canon's Colorado M-series launch and the emphasis on weather resistance for vehicle wraps and outdoor signage. Strong positioning.

One gap I'm seeing: your customers ask how to protect those prints for the long haul, and right now Canon doesn't have a go-to answer for protective films. We work with other equipment manufacturers to give their sales teams a complete durability solution they can confidently recommend—especially for premium projects where graphic lifespan is the deciding factor.

Would it make sense to share how a few of your competitors are using this as a differentiation play? Happy to send over a quick overview if helpful.

Best,
[Your name]

personalization_used.hook: Canon's Colorado M-series emphasizes weather resistance and outdoor performance, but lacks a recommended protective film partner to complete the durability story
personalization_used.value_prop_emphasized: Completing Canon's solution portfolio and enabling competitive differentiation through a strategic protective film partnership
